title: Vendor evaluation owner, trigger, and budget ceiling spread across turns, with a late correction
notes: Owner (Marcus) and the trigger (pricing tripled) appear early; the budget ceiling appears mid-session; a correction to the ceiling appears at the very end, separated by an unrelated noise turn — tests whether the extractor keeps the correction attached to the right entity across the gap.

turns.text: We're evaluating a new logging vendor for the platform.
Current vendor's pricing tripled at renewal.
Marcus is running the vendor eval.
Oh by the way, unrelated: the office coffee machine is finally fixed.
Back to logging — budget ceiling for the new vendor is $2,000/month.
One more thing before I forget — Marcus flagged that the ceiling actually needs to be $2,500/month, finance approved a bit more headroom after he pushed back.
Updated: $2,500/month is the real ceiling now, not $2,000.

gold_atoms.text: Marcus is leading the logging-vendor evaluation.
The vendor evaluation was triggered by the current vendor tripling its pricing at renewal.
The budget ceiling for the new logging vendor is $2,500/month — finance approved more headroom after Marcus pushed back on the original $2,000/month figure.
